notes.title: Free DLC New Taste – In Development
notes.content:
[h1]What awaits you in the [b]DLC New Taste[/b]?[/h1][h3]  
The [b]DLC[/b] is made in the [b]Quest[/b] genre where you will be able to:[/h3][list][*][p]Travel through [b]5 locations[/b] of KD Corp[/p][/*][*][p]Paint [b]16 new pictures[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Unravel the recipe mystery of the [b]new chips flavor[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Communicate with and help [b]3 new characters[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Encounter and discover [b]special events[/b]  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/9da742a47de95c16ebaf5d8bce364e1fcfa33c8f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]The main game will also be improved:[/h3][list][*][p]Special tasks from regular jobs will gain not only cosmetic but also practical meaning[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting in several locations has been reworked[/p][/*][*][p]The environment and job selection have been refined[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue voice effects inspired by Undertale will be added[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements for controller play and Steam Deck support  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/cdbe6f00d2018cf7b7f3d448517211a45d002ccc.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]The list may and most likely will grow, but one thing is clear: this DLC will be big and will significantly improve the game and your experience!!!  
[/p][h3]This is a free DLC that will be released as a patch.  
All game owners will receive it automatically.
[/h3][h2]Follow the progress[/h2][p]  
Subscribe to our [url="https://x.com/kirillov_prod"]Twitter account[/url] where updates on the [b]DLC[/b] are published [b]every week[/b].  
[/p][h2]Thank you <3[/h2][p]  
I am grateful to [b]you[/b] for [b]playing[/b], [b]liking[/b], [b]writing reviews[/b], and [b]sharing[/b] my game.  

Only thanks to your support did I dare to make this [b]DLC[/b], and because of you, it has already become better than before.  

P.S. With love, [i]Kirillov Dmitrii[/i] by Kirillov Production[/p]

notes.title: New menu, new music and a small piece of new DLC
notes.content:
[h1]Long time no see, we missed you <3[/h1][p][/p][p]We're working on a new game, and also continuing development on the [b]free DLC[/b] for [b]Sanechek: Lost Coins[/b][/p][p]The new DLC will tell us about how Sanechek works at "KD Chips". The release date isn't fully decided yet, but we're aiming to release it by the end of the year.[/p][p]As for the patch, we’ve redesigned the home menu — exploring and breathing in the room has become much more exciting as part of the DLC preparation.

Follow us on social networks and stay updated, thank you for being there

[url="https://x.com/kirillov_prod"]Twitter[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/e842fc15f77d742b80c5dc80f1f0ce83089e2f6f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]V1.3.5[/h2][p]1) New soundtracks added[/p][p] 1.1) Menu[/p][p] 1.2) Sleep[/p][p] 1.3) Home[/p][p] 1.4) Computer[/p][p] 1.5) Drawing[/p][p] 1.6) Point and Click[/p][p] 1.7) Last Day[/p][p]2) SFX added when the day changes[/p][p]3) Home menu redesigned[/p][p]4) Button added for upcoming free DLC[/p][p]5) Removed a slice of pizza from the cleaner lamp[/p]

notes.title: Newspaper for Japanese and Chinese fixed
notes.content:
Newspaper for Japanese and Chinese fixed

It turned out that the Godot engine couldn't figure out where to do line breaks in the newspaper. Because these languages ​​use hieroglyphs and don't use spaces between words. So we lovingly moved them ourselves. But if you think it's better to put line breaks in other places, tell us about it

notes.title: Sanechek: lost coins is out NOW! ٩(◕‿◕｡)۶
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/79be874313eeb0051e306f473da0c2a2442ea92b.png[/img]
⋆𐙚₊˚⊹♡
After six months, Sanechek is here! Woo-hoo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346950

Finally, you can help earn some coins for chips for this kitty-girl!

Tips about what you can do in Sanechek:
- first off, work five different jobs (how else did you think you'd earn coins for chipusu?)
- second, follow the storyline! Sanechek’s life will surprise you
- also, don’t forget to draw! Sanechek absolutely loves it
- and most importantly: enjoy!

Thank you to everyone who added it to their wishlists — may you always have chips at home <3

okey-dokey, I’m off to earn more coins, see ya! 
Sanechek
